data.summary:
**When:** Any phase except [either player's Command phase](vsdata:core-rule/command-phase), as it begins.

**Target:** An **ADEPTUS ARBITES**, **INQUISITORIAL AGENTS** or **ORDO HERETICUS GRENADES** unit of yours that is not in [Engagement Range](vsdata:core-rule/engagement-range) of any enemy unit.

**Effect:** Pick an enemy unit, other than **MONSTERS** and **VEHICLES**, up to 8" from the unit and visible to it. That enemy unit takes a [Battle-shock test](vsdata:core-rule/battle-shock). Its models' attacks also get -1 to [Hit](vsdata:core-rule/hit-rolls) for the rest of the phase.

combat.unresolved: The rule worsens a selected enemy unit's attacks on every unit, which the reading limits to the rule's own unit.
